messages:
Amanda Chen: Heads-up — Q3 planning ask from 2 large customers for per-tenant routing controls + soft isolation lanes. Can we do a quick alignment on scope and launch criteria?
Kai Patel: +1. Do we have a minimal set of controls the customers expect?
Raja Iyer: They want: 1) traffic steering by tenant -> region, 2) soft isolation (priority lanes, not hard shards), 3) predictable p95 latency for each lane.
Sophie Liao: For predictability we need: per-lane capacity reservations, burst policies, and fallback rules. Also want per-tenant telemetry surfaced to Console.
Amanda Chen: Customers also asked for a way to opt into a "shielded" lane during incidents — auto-fallback to cheaper-but-slower model is ok as long as SLAs are clearly defined.
Kai Patel: Proposal: 3-phase rollout. Phase 0 (API + policy DSL), Phase 1 (soft lanes + routing), Phase 2 (guardrail automation + telemetry+rollouts). Phase 0 targets Q3 alpha.
Raja Iyer: Launch criteria for Phase 0: API stable, end-to-end request path with policy evaluation, basic telemetry (per-tenant p95/p99, errors), unit tests for policy matcher.
Mike Torres: Ops ask: need throttle controls per-tenant + emergency kill switch. Also must ensure KV cache isolation so tenant cache spikes don't degrade others.
Sophie Liao: Can we define measurable SLOs for minimum viable lane? e.g., p95 < 150ms under 80% lane utilization, error rate <0.5% over 24h rolling window.
Amanda Chen: That seems reasonable. Add rollback threshold: if tail latency increases by >25% over baseline during canary, abort.
Kai Patel: How about canary cadence: start with 1% of traffic for 24h, then 10% for 48h, then 50% for 24h before full. Anything else from security/compliance?
Raja Iyer: Need data residency tag on policy so we can enforce region-only routing for regulated tenants. Also KMS-backed keys per-tenant for logs if required.
Sophie Liao: For API surface, draft policy DSL snippet:
```
policy {
  match tenant.id == "ACME" && region == "eu-west-1"
  route lane = "shielded-eu" priority = 100
  fallback route = "shared-eu" on_failure = {percentage:50}
}
```
Amanda Chen: Nice. Keep DSL small for Phase 0. Implementation detail: policy evaluation must be O(1) per request, no full-table scans.
Mike Torres: Runtime concerns: we need routing decision to be cacheable (TTL ~5s) and fallback path pre-warmed. Also ensure per-lane GPU reservations are configurable.
Kai Patel: Dependencies: (1) Console knobs for lane config, (2) telemetry backend update, (3) routing evaluator service, (4) customer-facing API. Estimate 6 sprints cross-team.
Amanda Chen: Prioritization ask: if customers sign contracts for dedicated lanes, we fast-track Phase 1. Otherwise default Q3 alpha + Q4 beta.
Raja Iyer: Customer-driven asks: document exact SLAs they'll require. Sales to confirm. We should include rollout playbook for on-call and capacity ops.
Sophie Liao: Also add migration plan for tenants currently pinned to dedicated capacity — re-route testing window and rollback process.
Deploy Bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled: infra-provisioner v2 will cut a canary tomorrow 08:00 UTC (ticket INF-2218).
Mike Torres: Let's block a 30-min sync Friday to lock Phase 0 API contract. I'll bring the ops checklist.
Amanda Chen: OK locking sync Fri 10:30 PT. Action items: Kai draft policy DSL spec, Raja draft launch criteria checklist, Sophie telemetry requirements, Mike ops runbook. Sales to confirm contract triggers.
Kai Patel: I'll put a PR with DSL README + example policies by Wed.
Raja Iyer: I'll draft SLA matrix and canary gates this afternoon.
Sophie Liao: Will list telemetry metrics and Console UI mockups by Thursday.
Mike Torres: Ops playbook and emergency runbooks by Thursday EOD.
Amanda Chen: Thanks all. If anyone spots a risk we missed, post here. Keep messages short. :thumbsup:
